description.p: Orbit downloads files over several connections at once, handles magnet links and .torrent files, and saves videos and music from sites like YouTube.

ul.li: Steady multi-connection downloads that resume after a crash or restart
BitTorrent with magnet links, file selection and torrent RSS feeds
Checksums verified automatically when the server publishes one
Lock downloads to a VPN interface, pause on metered connections
A command line, a web dashboard and an aria2-compatible interface
